meta.name: ad-creative
meta.description: 文案诊断助手适合市场营销、运营、产品、销售在用户提出“这段文案能打动人吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成摘要、诊断结论、行动建议和可复用交付物。

copy.tagline: 诊断文案效果并生成优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需快速判断文案是否打动目标用户
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose copy effectiveness and generate optimization suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly judge whether copy resonates with target users

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成文案诊断助手。当你提供文案或创意材料时，它会生成摘要、诊断结论、行动建议和可复用交付物，帮你判断文案是否打动人并给出优化方向。
howto.when: 当你问“这段文案能打动人吗”或需要分析广告文案、视频脚本、营销素材时触发。

say.text: 帮我诊断这段文案：限时优惠，立即抢购！
say.note: Claude 会分析文案并给出诊断结论和优化建议。

say.text: 分析这个视频脚本，目标是提高点击率。
say.note: Claude 会结合目标受众和平台给出行动建议。

say.text: 评估这个落地页的文案，受众是年轻白领。
say.note: Claude 会输出摘要和可复用交付物。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an ad copy diagnostic assistant. When you provide copy or creative materials, it generates a summary, diagnostic conclusions, action recommendations, and reusable deliverables to help evaluate if the copy is compelling and suggest improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'Is this copy compelling?' or need analysis of ad copy, video scripts, or marketing materials.

say_en.text: Diagnose this copy: Limited time offer, buy now!
Analyze this video script, goal is to increase click-through rate.
say_en.note: Claude will give action recommendations based on target audience and platform.

say_en.text: Evaluate this landing page copy, audience is young professionals.
say_en.note: Claude will output a summary and reusable deliverables.
